name: nexxus
description: Nexxus: mudanças na superfície vistas pelo radar do NISAR. NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nexxus/contract && concurrently -n api,web -c gray,red "npm run dev -w @nexxus/api" "npm run dev:http -w @nexxus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexxus/contract && npm run build -w @nexxus/api && npm run build -w @nexxus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nexxus/contract && npm run typecheck -w @nexxus/api && npm run typecheck -w @nexxus/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nexxus/web && npm run build -w @nexxus/contract && npm run test -w @nexxus/api
